title: AgentLoopService in-process implementation
description:
Implement AgentLoopService — the in-process implementation of AgentService — with
full unit tests using a mock agent driver.

Sections: 4 (AgentLoopService), 3.2 (Turn-Scoped Event Streams), 3.4 (ResumeSession
Validation — implementation)

Key deliverables:
- internal/agent/service.go — AgentLoopService struct, managedSession, NewAgentLoopService(),
  all AgentService methods (CreateSession, SendMessage, Continue, Steer, FollowUp, Abort,
  SubscribeEvents, ResumeSession, DestroySession, Close), EventPublisher interface,
  ServiceOption/WithMaxSessions
- internal/agent/agenttest/mock_driver.go — MockAgentDriver with TurnScript, TurnDelay,
  BlockOnStart, PanicOnStart for testing
- Unit tests (internal/agent/service_test.go):
  - Session lifecycle (create, get, list, destroy)
  - SendMessage/Continue with turn-scoped event streaming
  - Concurrent session independence
  - BusyError when turn already active
  - MaxSessions limit (CodeResourceExhausted)
  - Steer returns FailedPrecondition when idle
  - FollowUp valid in any state
  - DestroySession during active turn (force cancel)
  - ResumeSession with validation (schema version, role parsing, monotonicity, tool compat)
  - Close() graceful shutdown with drain deadline
  - EventPublisher mock verification

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc.md §3.2, §3.4, §4
- Test harness: docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc-test-harness.md §1, §4 (U1-U6), §5 (EP1-EP5)
- Depends on: aiag-rmv.1 (AgentService interface + types)
